Coded R22.31 (primary, undiagnosed mass right lower limb), M79.671 (pain right foot), and Z80.8 (family hx malignancy). E/M billed as 99213 (low MDM — single MRI ordered, no Rx management, no procedure today). MRI ordered but not performed today, so not separately billable. Removed unsupported M79.81 (hematoma). PMH hypothyroidism (E03.9) and hypertension (I10) retained as supporting_conditions only. No HCPCS items dispensed. SNOMED set deduplicated.
